title: Tutorial
body:
- Your attack keybind is how you dash.
- Cling Grip unlocks Climbing & Wall Jumps.
- Faydown Cloak unlocks Double Dash.
- Try mixing supers & hypers etc.
- You can't get hit while dashing.
- Don't spam dash on enemies!
- {key:key_settings} Settings & keybinds
- Using a controller is recommended.
- Have fun!
show: every time a save is loaded, once the player can move (not at the bench, not in a cutscene or the opening binding)
notes: user 2026-10-10: on each start of a save file, after they gain movement; text from the user

title: Cling Grip
body:
Madeline can now grab walls, climb and wall jump.

Hold the Dash button against a wall to hold on, and move up or down to climb.
Climbing tires her out: she flashes red just before she slips.
Jump next to a wall to wall jump,
or while holding on for a climb jump.
show: right after Cling Grip is picked up
notes: follows Silksong's own item message, which describes Hornet's own wall climbing

title: Faydown Cloak
body:
Madeline can now dash twice before landing.

Her hair turns pink while she still has both dashes.
show: right after Faydown Cloak is picked up
notes: follows Silksong's own item message, which still describes Hornet's double jump

title: Swift Step
body:
Madeline could already dash,
so Swift Step gives no new move.

Instead, it makes her dash stronger:
- Dashes go 25% further.
- The lock after hitting an enemy
  is 25% shorter.
show: right after Swift Step is picked up (and F8 in test builds)
notes: user 2026-10-11: first no card at all, then a card explaining the bonus in %

title: Drifter's Cloak
body:
Madeline can now glide.

Hold Jump while falling to glide with Celeste's jellyfish.
Glide into updrafts to ride them up.
show: right after Drifter's Cloak is picked up
notes: follows Silksong's own item message, which describes Hornet's float
